title: Iowa lead detonation results expected soon, EPA says
summary: The EPA conducted sampling at more than 130 structures in Iowa, including homes, schools, daycare centers and churches.

title: High school band raises $350K to stay for Macy's Thanksgiving parade
summary: Other marching bands from around the U.S. are also raising funds to cover the cost of staying in New York City after the parade was rescheduled for Saturday.

title: Powerful Thanksgiving Day storm causes flooding, power outages
summary: The storm hammered sections of the East Coast with torrential rain, high winds and flooding, knocking out power to hundreds of thousands of customers.

title: Trump claims "fake economic numbers" were released before election
summary: President Trump demanded an investigation into the Commerce Department's recent revising of the GDP, which happens routinely.

title: How to protect your packages from porch pirates
summary: 'Tis the season for online orders and holiday deliveries. But those packages stacking up outside the house are a lure for thieves, just waiting to steal your stuff. Jason Allen has more on protecting your items.

title: Inside Visa's effort to protect your money from AI holiday shopping scams
summary: Friday is Black Friday, with Cyber Monday just around the corner, and a lot of shopping will be done by AI assistants. Scammers are using the same technology to rip off customers. Ash-har Quraishi has an exclusive look inside Visa's innovation center.

title: Severe weather this Thanksgiving hits U.S. from California to New York
summary: A Thanksgiving nor'easter brought powerful winds that knocked down a tree, crushing a home in Maryland. Major floods hit Virginia and New Jersey and the California coast were hit by king tides. Tom Hanson reports and Scott Padgett has the forecast.

title: Texas town helps high school marching band stay in postponed Thanksgiving Day Parade
summary: After the Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed, a Texas high school saw an outpouring of support to make sure the marching band could still perform.

title: Thanksgiving Day Parade performers vow to march on despite postponement
summary: The postponed Thanksgiving Day Parade has set up an unprecedented series of challenges for tens of thousands of people walking, working and watching along the parade route. Lilia Luciano reports.

title: Thanksgiving travel nightmare hits airports amid powerful nor'easter
summary: More than 2,000 flights have been delayed this Thanksgiving, and more than 400 were canceled as a powerful nor'easter, Cristian Benavides reports.

title: Trump signs severe weather disaster declarations from Mar-a-Lago on Thanksgiving
summary: President Trump celebrated Thanksgiving at his resort in Palm Beach, Florida. He signed disaster declarations for Florida in the wake of severe weather. Weijia Jiang has more.
